name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Rc5X
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#all-actions) sends an RC5X (Marantz Extended RC5) infrared remote code to a remote transmitter.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The address to send, see dumper output for more details. Range is 0 to 0x1F.

config_entries.label: Command
config_entries.description: The RC5X command to send. Range is 0 to 0x7F.

config_entries.label: Extension
config_entries.description: The RC5X extension field to send. Range is 0 to 0x3F.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
